newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks ease.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks ease.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, lost 0.81 point to 316.06 on Monday in thin traded volume as shares of two leading companies fell, brokers said.
Provisional volume transacted was posted at 2.60 million rupees on 198,266 shares from 3.93 million rupees on 228,213 shares on Friday.
Brokers said Semdex was pushed down by losing stocks of State Bank of Mauritus and conglomerate Rogers.
State Bank shed 10 cents to 8.40 rupees on 14,900 shares and Rogers was 2.50 rupees lower at 86 on 327 shares.
Several stocks in the sugar sector continued to move upwards, sustaining a rally which started last Wednesday in anticipation of record proceeds from the country's sugar exports in 1996/97.
"The sugar exports forecasts are still having a bearing on these stocks. But for how long again?" one broker said.

"Revenue for the sugar sector is bright this year but don't forget it's largely thanks to the rupee's depreciation and that we did not have any major cyclone which could have affected the crop," he added.
Mon Desert Alma (ordinary) gained 4.0 rupees to 99, the Mount climbed 40 cents to 17.90 rupees and Savannah (preference) rose 5 rupees to 110. But these stocks were not traded.
Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 35 rupees on 4,105 shares.
The rest of the market remained thinly traded in the absence of investors' interests, brokers said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 71 rupees on 4,000 shares. British American Insurance remained at 7.20 rupees on 11,500 shares.
Mauritius Oil Refineries lost 20 cents to 9.50 rupees on 450 shares. Consolidated Investment Trust was flat at 9.00 rupees on 111,000 shares.
Investment based Fincorp was unchanged at 71 rupees on 1,755 shares and Promotion And Development (PAD) was stable at 15 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Happy World Foods gained 10 cents to 14.10 rupees on 600 shares. Oil concern Shell Mauritius lost 10 cents to 14.90 rupees on 2,150 shares.
Hotel company Sun Resorts was unchanged at 35.70 rupees on 3,179 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius rose 50 cents to 49.50 rupees on 1,100 shares.
